title: Entity-Switched Datasets: An Approach to Auditing the In-Domain Robustness of Named Entity Recognition Models
reasoning: The paper's primary focus is on auditing AI models for fairness, specifically by creating datasets to measure performance disparities across entities from different national origins. This directly evaluates an ethical dimension of AI systems, as fairness and bias concerning demographic groups are central topics in AI ethics. The work is framed around uncovering and quantifying these performance gaps, which it explicitly links to 'fairness implications'.
